title: ui(fields): the permission-ref picker lists permission sets by name only, so once two packages hold one name it offers two options with one value and a grant written through it names no package
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

Follow-up of #32537 (PR #32769). Part of #31527 (ADR-0150). On the release line; does not gate #31698 PR-2 (epic seat): with two holders, a grant this picker writes with no package is read by the server as granting nothing (fail closed), and no first-party package pair holds one name.

Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible once #31698 PR-2 lands). reach: read on `main` `f1bb362c`; the card thread of #32537 recorded it as out of its PR's scope (report 6828732821, `out_of_scope_findings`). The card #32537 lists this widget in its caller list ("Read-only by name, same card"); its PR covers the other four callers and leaves this one, so the seat carries it here.

## 维护者速读

授权表单里选权限集用的是 `permission-ref` 下拉框，它只按名字列出权限集，写入的也只有名字。#31698 PR-2 之后，两个包可以各带一个同名权限集（比如 `sales_rep`）。到那时这个下拉框会出现两个值相同、分不清是哪个包的选项；通过它写下的授权不带包，而服务端遇到两个包都持有的名字、又没指明包时，判为不授予任何权限。这种情况服务端判为不授予（fail closed），第一方包里也没有同名的一对，所以专题席判定它不卡 PR-2，只需在发版前修好。

## What happens

- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx` (`permission-ref` → `GET /api/v1/meta/permission`) builds its options as `{ value: item.name, label: itemText(item) }` (~:319–325) and writes only the name (the docblock, ~:37–46: "the value written is the NAME — one string").
- Its users on `main`: `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` ~:107, the grant's set column), `sys_user` (~:395), `sys_idp_group_mapping` (~:139, ~:187), and `text` action params (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` ~:266).
- With two holders of one name served by `/meta/permission` (one item per `(package, name)`, ADR-0150 D4), the picker lists two options with the same `value`. Picking either writes the bare name. A grant row with no `permission_set_package` on a name two packages hold is read as granting nothing (`storedPermissionSetScope`, ADR-0150 D8 R1; mirrored client-side by `storedGrantHolders` in PR #32769).

## Expected

- Where the served registry has more than one holder of a name, the picker offers one option per holder, each naming its package beside the label (the generic `{label} ({name})` text plus the holder, no new product-named widget), and the stored value addresses that holder. On a grant form that carries `permission_set_package`, the holder's package is written there, as Setup's assignment page does after PR #32769.
- One holder per name, and the environment's own set: options, value written and screen unchanged (CONTROL).
- A form whose target has no package column (an action param, an idp mapping) is judged against what its server reader accepts. If it can only name a set by its name, say so in the PR and refuse to offer an ambiguous pick, ⛔ never resolving it by order.

Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/fields`; widening its value shape, or how a form pairs the two columns, may be `Clause-②: yes`, so declare it). Triage decides the grade; it sits on the #31527 release line (it does not gate #31698 PR-2).

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue permission-ref package holder` → 29 hits and `is:issue RegistryRefField package` → 8 hits. None covers the two-holder picker. The nearest are #32537 (its caller list names this widget), #32164 (closed: the server doors), #27861 (closed: the Permission Sets tab showed API names) and #32250 (a refused grant on `/data` names no candidates).

Related: #32537, PR #32769, #31698, #31527.
